svg.title: TuxBox runtime compatibility
svg.desc: Current runtime capabilities, retail output and Xbox DLL coverage. A checked circle marks complete coverage, a half-filled circle partial coverage and an open ring incomplete coverage. Each bar shows the fraction of reviewed DLL exports verified in TuxBox.

g.title: The Matrix Awakens
g.desc: Trial menu-video-audio. Title code reached. Frame verified. Unresolved imports in loaded DLLs: 1

g.title: Xbox library coverage
g.text: 16 tracked DLLs · TuxBox and reference providers
Bars show verified TuxBox exports / all DLL exports. Status also covers methods and reference runtimes.

g.title: d3d12_xs.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 35/54 (64.8%). TuxBox Rust D3D12 provider. The retail run uses patched TomBox. TuxBox creates a device for profile 0x20002 and submits command lists with verified GPU output. Four exports handle standard 1.0 and 1.1 root signatures. The reference path accepts Frosty's 0x20004 profile and renders the menu controls and movies.

dxcompiler_xs.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 2/4 (50%). TuxBox PE forwarder to desktop DXC. Both SDK factories create a desktop DXC utility object through the Xbox DLL. Tests check blob contents, lifetime and use of a caller-supplied allocator.

xmem.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 6/32 (18.8%). TuxBox Rust allocator. The retail reference run uses TomBox. Six named and ordinal exports cover allocation/free, working-set statistics and virtual allocation. Guest tests check alignment, reservation, page access and lifetime.

xg_xs.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 1/21 (4.8%). TuxBox texture address computer. Computes linear and 4 KiB tiled layouts for single-slice 2D textures in 41 formats. The supplied library and TuxBox matched on 6,231,134 texel or compressed-block addresses. A separate guest checked four texture shapes from the Frosty trace.

xgameruntime.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 0/5 (0%). ScarlettX reference runtime with a task-queue fix. Frosty initializes the reference runtime and enters Unreal startup. A paired control verifies termination of a queue with a manual completion port.

xcrdapi.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 0/118 (0%). TomBox storage bridge to desktop DirectStorage. DStorageGetFactory supplies the storage path Frosty uses to initialize its I/O dispatcher and mount its IoStore container.

gameconfighelper.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 3/24 (12.5%). TuxBox package registry helper using Win32 and WinRT. Implements three of the 24 exports in the reviewed Windows Game Runtime helper. The guest obtains an owned UTF-16 package path and opens configuration keys in both supported registry hives, including the GameCore machine key. Boundary lengths, Unicode and missing keys matched the supplied helper.

GameInput.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 0/1 (0%). TomBox GameInput bridge with TuxBox mouse and keyboard mapping. The retail menu accepts keyboard, mouse and Xbox D-pad input. A virtual Xbox controller verifies analog readings, simultaneous button presses, hotplug and keyboard fallback through Proton XInput.
AcpHal.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 0/10 (0%). TomBox audio hardware abstraction. Frosty starts its mixer and submits an eight-channel buffer with the reference AcpHal provider.

XAudio2_9.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 8/10 (80%). TuxBox Xbox ordinal exports backed by system XAudio2. Eight exports cover all five static imports in Frosty. The guest creates engines through all three tested factory ordinals, instantiates three effects, pans a source and measures the signal on each stereo channel.

GameChat2.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 11/70 (15.7%). TuxBox in-process chat manager. Eleven exports implement session setup and cleanup, a remote-user roster, locality, per-user identity and context, and encoding bitrate. Seven are among Frosty's 15 delay imports. The guest checks duplicates, capacity, removal and stale handles against the supplied DLL.

mfplat.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 1/140 (0.7%). TuxBox sample bridge with TomBox and Proton Media Foundation. The bridge provides the D3D12 video-sample path. Guest readback and retail movie comparisons verify decoded output.

mfhevcdec.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 0/5 (0%). TuxBox transform adapter around the supplied HEVC decoder. The adapter delivers synchronized D3D12 NV12 samples. Original intro and chase footage passed decoded-frame comparisons.

mfh264dec.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 1/1 (100%). TuxBox transform adapter around the supplied H.264 decoder. The registered H.264 transform returns D3D12 samples for both 1024 × 512 menu previews.

mfreadwrite.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 2/7 (28.6%). TuxBox synchronous PCM source reader. Opens seekable PCM RIFF/WAVE streams, Windows file paths and escaped file URLs. The guest compares 2,501 stereo frames and checks stream selection, seeking, timestamps, end of stream and invalid inputs.

MSAudDecMFT.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 2/2 (100%). TuxBox AAC transform adapter using GE-Proton's host decoder. Handles the first format change and end-of-stream drain. On GE-Proton the guest decoded 25 generated and 96 Frosty AAC-LC packets into 48 kHz six-channel PCM. Each channel was compared with FFmpeg.
Guest regression checks
